grammar: typescript

--- tql ---
def starts_with_use(@ident): @ident | text ~ /^use/;
def is_hook(@ident): starts_with_use(@ident) and (@ident | text ~ /^[a-z]/);

. // identifier | is_hook(.)

--- source ---
function useFoo() {}
function Bar() {}

(node identifier)) (call is_hook .)))
